messages.content: 紐約目前的交通狀況如何？

function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.content: 抱歉，我無法提供紐約市目前的即時交通狀況。建議您使用像 Google 地圖、Apple 地圖或其他即時交通資訊服務（例如 Waze 或地方交通局網站）來查詢最新的道路擁堵與事故訊息。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "紐約目前的交通狀況如何？" meaning "What is the current traffic situation in New York?" We need to provide an answer. The user wants real-time traffic data. We can use the geocode_address function to get a location. But we don't have a function to get traffic. There's no function for traffic. So we cannot fetch real-time traffic. We should respond that we can't provide real-time traffic updates. Possibly we can suggest using Google Maps or other services. We should not hallucinate. So we respond politely that we can't provide real-time traffic.
